articles.title: Oil tumbles as Trump cancels attack on Iran to reach nuclear deal
articles.description: Oil prices dropped significantly on Monday after President Trump paused new Iran attacks. OPEC+ approved an oil production increase, but market impact remains limited. Shipping data shows reduced traffic in the Strait of Hormuz after recent incidents.
